races.paceDynamic: Castle Ivers, Triple Crown Ted, Bertie's Ballet and Newtown Rambler will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with at least three confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead. The strong pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves over this 2m trip on testing soft ground. Hold-up horses like Bibe Mus, Secret Force and Caballo De Guerra will benefit from the guaranteed strong gallop, while prominent racers may get caught between paces. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can deliver late kicks off a solid pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly strong and sustained throughout
scenarios.body: The gallop will set up perfectly for closers who can pick off tired leaders in the final furlong. Bibe Mus and Secret Force have the class to capitalize on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one horse can sit handy without getting embroiled in early pace battles
scenarios.body: A horse like The Gray Ghost or Magna Victor could get the perfect trip just off the pace. They avoid the early speed duel but stay close enough to strike when the leaders falter.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes more measured than expected due to tactical riding
scenarios.body: One of the natural leaders could get away with softer fractions and prove hard to peg back. Castle Ivers has the class to dictate terms if allowed an easier lead than anticipated.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the multiple front-runners go too fast too early and burn out
scenarios.body: The race could become a sprint finish between mid-division horses who avoided the early carnage. This would suit horses that naturally race in midfield positions.

races.paceDynamic: Throatlash and Tanking Along will ensure genuine early pace from the start, with both having natural front-running tendencies and likely to contest the early lead. Risk De Pluie and Koukeo sitting prominent behind them should maintain honest gallop throughout. The combination of soft ground and testing 2m4f trip will create stamina demands in the closing stages, blunting any late kick. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and proven stayers who can track the pace without getting into an early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Grind
scenarios.trigger: If Throatlash and Tanking Along maintain strong early pace without one dropping back
scenarios.body: The honest tempo stretches the field and eliminates hold-up horses who struggle to make ground on soft ground. Risk De Pluie and Marty McFly are perfectly positioned to strike from prominent positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Throatlash gets an uncontested lead with Tanking Along settling behind
scenarios.body: The class horse gets ideal conditions to control the race and prove too strong in the finish. The Grafter and Pleasington may close but lack the pace positioning to get there.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners go too hard early and weaken significantly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where hold-up horses can finally make their move effective. Pleasington and The Grafter benefit most from this scenario unfolding.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Duel Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Throatlash and Tanking Along engage in a fierce early battle and both fade
scenarios.body: The race falls apart completely allowing mid-division horses to inherit the contest. Koukeo and Marty McFly can capitalize on their more conservative early positioning.

races.paceDynamic: Green Angel will lead unchallenged from the start with no other natural front runners in the field. Behind him, Lirion, Dropematthestation, Linalene, Bohemond Antioch and Magna Patch will track in a prominent group, while Penn Avenue and Culzean settle at the rear as hold-up horses. Green Angel's uncontested lead should create a sustainable gallop that will suit horses who can travel strongly in behind and finish. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Green Angel maintains a steady gallop without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The even tempo allows prominent runners like Lirion and Dropematthestation to travel smoothly before striking, while hold-up horses get their preferred strong pace to run at. Form horses with tactical speed benefit most from this measured build-up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly testing in the soft ground over 2m
scenarios.body: The combination of testing conditions and solid gallop creates a strong end-to-end test that suits horses held up for late runs. Penn Avenue's 7lb claim and Culzean's fresh hold-up style become major assets.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Green Angel Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If no horse can quicken sufficiently to peg back the leader's advantage
scenarios.body: Green Angel's uncontested lead becomes insurmountable when the field fails to produce enough pace pressure late on. His recent consistency at this trip keeps him ahead of a laboured finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Green Angel goes too slow early and turns it into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a messy tactical affair that becomes a lottery in the soft ground. Horses with the most natural speed from wherever they are positioned hold all the cards.

races.paceDynamic: Twinjets and Myretown will dictate proceedings as confirmed front runners, with Twinjets likely to grab the early initiative given his consistent lead style and Jay Tidball's aggressive riding. The pair will set an honest gallop over the 2m4½f trip on testing soft ground, stretching the field throughout. Il Ridoto, Califet En Vol and Donnacha will track in prominent positions, while the hold-up brigade of Hoe Joly Smoke, Jipcot, Dubai Days and Hombre De Guerra face a tactical disadvantage. This pace scenario strongly favours prominent runners who can stay in touch without being detached by the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Twinjets and Myretown maintain a strong tempo throughout without one dropping away early.
scenarios.body: The honest pace will stretch the hold-up horses too far back on the testing ground, allowing the prominent runners to kick clear turning for home. Those tracking the leaders get first run while the backmarkers face too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Twinjets gets loose on the front end with Myretown failing to go the pace.
scenarios.body: The Paul Nicholls-trained leader builds an unassailable advantage as the field struggles to close on the soft ground. His superior ratings and form give him the class edge when allowed to dictate completely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses with both leaders weakening significantly before the final circuit.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair allowing the hold-up horses to conserve energy and mount late challenges. Skelton's booking of Hoe Joly Smoke becomes significant as stamina tells in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Twinjets and Myretown both pull up or fall early leaving no clear leader.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a muddling affair with the prominent runners having to make their own pace. This tactical disruption could favour any horse whose jockey adapts quickest to the changed circumstances.

races.paceDynamic: The Four Sixes, Came From Nowhere, Phantomofthepoints and Spectacularsunrise will ensure a fierce gallop from the off, with multiple confirmed front-runners unwilling to settle. This sustained pace over 2m5½f on testing soft ground will severely test stamina reserves and expose any fitness doubts. The relentless tempo will set up a finish where horses with proven staying power and tactical speed can strike from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those who can finish from prominent positions, as the early leaders will pay for their exertions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses strike late
scenarios.trigger: If the confirmed pace battle unfolds as expected with multiple leaders going hard
scenarios.body: The stamina-sapping gallop will empty the tanks of early leaders, allowing patient horses with proven finishing kicks to sweep past in the final furlong. Hold-up specialists with strong recent form will benefit most from this collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker takes over
scenarios.trigger: If one horse can track the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle
scenarios.body: A horse settling in fourth or fifth can conserve energy while staying close enough to strike, timing their move perfectly as the leaders weaken. This tactical approach suits horses who can travel well just off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and multiple leaders stop quickly
scenarios.body: The race will become a crawl in the middle stages before a mad dash to the finish, suiting horses who need time to wind up their run. Late-closing horses with tactical speed will have the best chance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front-runner survives battle
scenarios.trigger: If Came From Nowhere or The Four Sixes can dictate without serious pressure
scenarios.body: One leader gets an easier time than expected and has enough left to resist late challenges, capitalizing on their class advantage. Their superior racing weight and recent form would prove decisive.

races.paceDynamic: Rocheval and Society Soldier will contest the early lead, with Rocheval's more established front-running style likely to dictate terms from the outset. Seven horses (Alentejo, I Am Max, Draco Malfoy, Billy Boi Blue, Irish Champ, Don Rafael, Just Ennemi) wanting prominent positions will create a congested pack behind the leaders, setting up potential traffic problems at the business end. The honest gallop over 3m½f on testing ground will stretch the field, with stamina becoming paramount in the final mile. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and deliver their challenge when the pace-pressed leaders begin to tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine and the prominent pack becomes congested
scenarios.body: The front-runners and prominent racers will weaken from 2f out, allowing the patient hold-up horses to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Eyed, Woodland Park and Hidden History are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent racers can secure a clean run without getting trapped
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a battle between the well-positioned prominent horses who avoided trouble, with their forward position proving decisive over the stay-at-home types. Draco Malfoy and I Am Max have the class to capitalize if getting first run.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Rocheval dominates early and the chasing pack fails to organize effectively
scenarios.body: The leader will build an unassailable advantage through the middle stages, with the soft ground and extended trip playing to his stamina strengths. Society Soldier could also benefit if tracking the winner throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightweight Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the testing conditions and extended trip find out the classier but higher-weighted runners
scenarios.body: The handicap will come into play as the marathon trip takes its toll, allowing the bottom weights to stay on strongly. Shoeshine Boy's recent form and veteran experience could prove decisive.

The large contingent of hold-up horses including Summergrounds, Balboa, Travis Wheatley, and Westoftignes will need the pace to collapse late to be competitive. scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surge

scenarios.label: D
